visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a shot of a large GU building exterior, then cuts to the interior of a GU store where a woman with short dark hair, wearing a fuzzy grey sweater and a tulle skirt, stands holding a shopping basket and smiling at the camera. (2) A series of quick cuts follow showing her domestic life: she is seen with a young child in a stroller petting a small guinea pig, and the child is shown eating independently with a spoon. (3) She is seen dressing the child in a traditional blue Japanese outfit and posing for a birthday photo with a man and the child, smiling happily. (4) The scene shifts back to the GU store where she browses through racks of winter clothing, showing puffer jackets on mannequins and various styles of boots on shelves. (5) She then models two specific outfits in front of a wooden door background; the first is a grey knit cardigan with a black skirt, and the second is a brown knitted dress with a fuzzy vest. (6) A man is shown outside pushing the child in a stroller, both waving. (7) Close-up shots of GU price tags and a large tax-free sign are shown to emphasize affordability. (8) The video concludes with her in the store, holding up fleece jackets and waving goodbye energetically.
